reason: I already get plenty of café and salon DMs and I'm happy doing barter, and my manager screens the sketchy ones. A middleman taking a fee from the business just means the business will offer me less, so why would I route my deals through it?
objection: Whatever they say about 'fee on top', the café has one budget. If they pay Mitra, my payout shrinks, and I lose the easy barter relationships I have now.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a few creators my size in Bengaluru actually getting paid invites through it that were higher than what those places offered them directly.
